propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was the named contract owner for the out-of-hours support outsourcing agreement and signed the 2023 renewal within delegated authority from the chief operating officer.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the ownership and the work sample shows the contract schedule, the signature page and the delegation letter.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate managed a service desk of nine analysts on two shifts against customer SLAs.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the team and its scope.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the major-incident bridge for priority-one incidents with customer updates every 30 minutes.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the incident process directly.

expectedGap: ITIL 4 Foundation is verified on the register; the Managing Professional designation is not held.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the documented contract ownership and renewal authority and the verified Foundation certificate; do not describe the candidate as holding Managing Professional.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which Managing Professional modules the candidate has completed and when the remaining ones are planned.
